purpose: Test whether four fixed identities remain recognizable while 1-star, 3-star, 5-star, and 7-star forms become unmistakably more exceptional in an ultra-realistic cinematic direction.
summonRule: Only 1-star through 5-star heroes may be summoned; 6-star and 7-star forms are reached through evolution.
comparisonRules: Each sheet contains the same person four times in left-to-right rank order.
Face, age, body proportions, skin, hair identity, and durable recognition cues remain stable.
Five-star is a major transformation rather than an incremental costume upgrade.
Seven-star is a nearly unattainable mythic end-state and must read decisively beyond five-star.
No printed stars, labels, affinity colors, weapons, card frames, or UI are baked into candidate pixels.
Candidates are not approved or runtime assets.
